x: Goldie Sayers placed 11th in the Javelin, not so far behind her season's best, but Scot Thompson was out of sorts as he was only able to manage 48.89 in the discus, some 7 metres down on his best for the year.

In the European U23 Championships, we were represented by Tim Abeyie (gold 4x100 m), Tim Benjamin (silver 400 m), Darren Chin (gold 4 x 100 m), Dominic Girdler, Chris Lambert (gold 200 m and 4 x 100 m), Samson Oni, Goldie Sayers and Scot Thompson.
Kevin Brown, just back competing after injury, and 21 year old Scot Thompson, gained two seconds to start the team off to a better than expected start.
New member Dan Donovan made an impressive start while under 23 year olds Scot Thompson, Greg Beard, Seni Majekodunmi, and Dominic Girdler made significant contributions.

It was like that all afternoon: Scot Thompson also has an injury problem and would only do the discus - until he saw how a few more points might save the day and offered a “standing” shot put as well; an unfit Darren Chin won the 100m, ran the sprint relay - and then let himself be persuaded to run…

Next up was Scot Thompson who opened the discus comp with a near 53 metre effort. A distance he was not to improve on and one which Inter-Counties champion Leith Marar chased but could not match; but third and first spots added valuable points.
